title: Appraisals
description: Stage 2 Haiku output. Maps tonight's events (dossier facts, last verdict, shelved streak, optional audience reactions) to agent-emotion-core appraisal inputs. The events array is piped to `affect_core.py appraise --json -`. The LLM only appraises; the engine owns the dynamics and the state.

event.description: One appraisal event in agent-emotion-core CLI input format. Only `event` is required; omitted fields take the engine defaults.

topics.description: Topic and technique-family tags, at most 8 of at most 60 characters each (affect_core.py limits, so nothing is silently truncated). The engine uses them for likes, dislikes and habituation.

relevance.description: How much the event matters to the crew's goals and likes.

congruence.description: Goal congruence: -1 is bad for the crew, 1 is good.

novelty.description: How new the event is to the crew.

praiseworthiness.description: Moral or quality judgement of the responsible agent's action.

control.description: How much the crew can influence the outcome.

source.description: Where the event came from: dossier, verdict, ledger, discussion.

thread.description: Grouping thread id, for example the night's date.

relationship.description: Relationship context for the event, as accepted by affect_core.py appraise(). Omit unless the event involves a relationship.

perceived_emotion.description: Emotion expressed by another agent in the event (for example an audience reaction), if any.
